question: Do split-graph systems preserve every toy relation, lower actual F4 handled degree and width at matched cardinality, and construct complete d=3,4,5 bases across fixed prospective fields?

claims.text: Complete model and dense roots equal independent signed group references on every completed target.
Compare actual F4 handled degree and width for graph/control and secant/dense at matched cardinality.
claims.if_supported: Report the exact observed scope, branch costs and failures; no timing or asymptotic inference.
claims.if_not_supported: Retain null/regression; homogeneous degree cannot fill measured F4 fields.

claims.text: Attempt all nine prospective field/degree construction cells and verify every successful base has exactly 2d rational abscissae.
External novelty, P256/17-term applicability and ECDLP parity are outside these measurements.

arms.description: Complete split graph, three variables, all four sign branches.
Identical graph point set; exact dense membership and S3; two variables.
Matched-size control; explicit exact membership retained in all four secant branches.
The same control in dense membership plus S3, two variables.
Supplied G+G=2G and G+2G=3G through the same exporter and verifier.

stopping_rules.rule: Audit: all36 finite arm-target cells,4*17^3 model assignments and17^2 dense assignments per cell;120s cap.
Ladder: all9 fields/degrees;256 curve and512 graph proposal caps;120s internal,180s outer.
F4:10s child timeout and1800s outer panel cap; all partial failures retained; no favorable rerun.

invalidation_rules: FP/FN or missed positive control prevents an affected correctness/degree benefit claim.
Missing/censored cells are not successes; homogeneous theorem never fills measured F4 fields.
Local clocks do not support speedup inference.
Incomplete field counters prevent a complete operation-cost claim.

decision_rule.text: First complete exact correctness and positive controls. Report per-target/branch handled-degree and width differences, charging every branch and failed attempt. Report all9 construction cells and work. Lower degree alone does not establish lower relation cost.
decision_rule.threshold: zero completed-case correctness errors; strict degree drops reported only at observed scope
decision_rule.statistic: complete finite distributions and paired differences
decision_rule.interval: none; exact finite counts with censored outcomes retained
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: per-cell degree difference; actual matrix/operation counts and exact yield denominator

graphs: construction work by field and degree

inadmissible: Research launch before genuine checkpoint/backend admission or explicit named owner exception.
Discarded branches, target failures, construction rejects, duplicates or unsupported metrics.
Conflating input, homogeneous, final basis and actual F4 degrees.
Success-conditioned curve replacement, resource expansion or P256/rho/novelty extrapolation.
